Privacy

Privacy policy.

What this site collects, how advertising works, and the choices you have.

Information we collect

AI Tool Trail is a static website. We do not require an account and do not ask you to submit personal information to browse the directory.

Cookies and advertising

This site uses Google AdSense to show ads. Google and its partners use cookies and similar technologies to serve and measure ads, which may be based on your visits to this and other websites. Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads based on your visit to this site and other sites on the internet.

You can learn how Google uses data from sites that use its services at policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites, and manage personalised advertising at adssettings.google.com. You can also opt out of third-party vendor cookies at aboutads.info.

Server logs

Our hosting and content-delivery providers may process standard technical data, such as IP address, browser type and requested pages, to deliver and secure the website.

External links

Tool profiles link to third-party websites. We are not responsible for their content or privacy practices.

Changes

We may update this policy as the site changes. The current version is always published on this page.
